title: Birth in Port Island and his father the bass player
summary: Summers was born September 15, 1903 across the river from Baton Rouge; his father L.M. Summers played string bass with several country bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: 1903, September the 15th. Was that in New Orleans? No, in Port Island, Louisiana. Oh yeah. How far is that from here? About 190 miles from...cross the river. Cross the river from Baton Rouge.
Uh huh. Did any family play instruments before you?
My father. Yeah. What was he? He was a bass player, L.M. Summers.
Uh huh. What was it, brass bass or string bass? Uh, string bass. Uh huh. Do you remember any of the bands he played with?
Well, he played with Claiborne Williams. Uh huh. He played with the Grandison Tango. Uh huh. And he played with the, uh, Gray Stevenson Band from Port Island, Louisiana. Uh huh.
